comment: A fixed box is contained by an ancestor with a transform (also translate, rotate, scale), perspective, a filter, a backdrop-filter or will-change naming one of them (or contain); not by a mask, will-change: opacity or transform-origin (those fixed boxes stack at the viewport's bottom left); adding a transform moves it into its holder; will-change: position contains absolutely positioned boxes only. Captured at rest, after the page scrolls (the viewport-fixed boxes stay) and with #h14 transformed.
